about: Hermes config.yaml texts and the MCP inventory source the minimal reader must report for each. Generated once from synthetic configurations dumped by PyYAML and by Hermes's ruamel writers, plus hand-written cases. Every expectation was checked against Hermes's own enabled/trust/tools.include rules applied to PyYAML safe_load and to Hermes's ruamel YAML 1.1 safe_load: the reader either matches both or reports unparsed.

cases.yaml:
model:
  default: gpt-6-astra
  provider: custom
toolsets:
- hermes-cli
- web
mcp_servers:
  agentlayer:
    command: /private/bin/agentlayer-mcp
    args:
    - --journal
    - private-argument
    env:
      AGENTOOL_COLLAB_DB: private-env-value
    tools:
      include:
      - collab_next
      - collab_task_*
  agenttool:
    url: https://private.example/mcp
    headers:
      Authorization: Bearer private-bearer-token
    enabled: false
    trust: untrusted
  telescope:
    command: npx
    args:
    - -y
    - private-package@1.2.3
    enabled: true
    trust: full
    tools:
      include: []
      exclude:
      - delete_*
    timeout: 120
platform_hints:
  cli:
    append: 'Answer briefly: no tables, # no headings'
compression:
  enabled: true
  threshold: 0.6
